name: GhostInput
description: Headless native text field. useGhostInput owns the string model and disabled/readonly/invalid/required; GhostInput is the thin unstyled element. Themed visual props live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled value. Later changes are ignored. Also the form-reset seed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Applies native disabled semantics, prevents editing and sequential focus, and omits the field from form submit.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Consumer-owned validity. Sets aria-invalid and data-state=invalid. Does not mirror native ValidityState.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled value. Omit for uncontrolled mode. An empty string is a real controlled value, not unset.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Applies native readonly semantics. The field stays focusable and is submitted, but cannot be edited.

props.name: type
props.description: Native text-like type (text, search, email, password, tel, url). Checkbox, radio, file, and number are out of scope.

models.description: v-model binding for the input string. Updates on the native input event.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the native input when it is mounted.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native input after mount, or `null` before mount.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Moves focus to the native input when it is mounted and not disabled.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Consumer-owned invalid. Wins over disabled and readonly when more than one applies.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable field. Prefer the native disabled attribute when both apply. Omitted while invalid.

states.name: readonly
states.description: Read-only field. Omitted while invalid or disabled.

keyboard.Tab: Move sequential focus into or out of the field when it is not disabled.
keyboard.Enter: May submit an ancestor form for text and search types.
